lookForward.fits: The Met's first patrol went out at 6 pm on 29 September 1829.
lookForward.headline: At six this evening, 197 years of bobbies
lookForward.line: On 29 September 1829, at six o’clock, the first thousand constables of the new Metropolitan Police walked out of their stations in blue tailcoats and top hats: the world’s first modern police force. Say good evening to one on the way home.
